name: Cheney Brothers - Florence SC (new cold DC)

fieldNotes.siteStatus: GREENFIELD UNDER CONSTRUCTION. Roster coordinates land on an active earthwork/grading pad in the Pee Dee Commerce City East Industrial Park. Latest available Maxar satellite and Feb-2024 Street View both show bare graded earth, silt fencing, and construction equipment - NO building, docks, gate, or trailers exist in imagery.
fieldNotes.planned: Per A M King and FCEDP, the completed building will be a 386,047 sq ft refrigerated/freezer DC on ~50 acres with 45 dock positions; a $42.5M expansion with 85 jobs was announced March 2026. These figures are planned, not yet visible.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Planned 45 docks per A M King, but band reported as NONE because no building/docks are visible in imagery.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Drawn around the visible graded site footprint (~50 acres), bounded by Florence Harllee Blvd to the south; this is the planned property, not a measured operational yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - edge-of-town industrial park off I-95, surrounded by farmland and scattered DCs.

citations.claim: SC Governor announcement of Cheney Brothers Florence County expansion, project still in build-out (cumulative $108.5M, 365 jobs).
Cheney Brothers $42.5M expansion at 2491 Florence Harllee Blvd, 85 new jobs; facility first broke ground 2023 and is still being built out.

verification.rationale: Cheney Brothers (PFG broadline) greenfield/expansion at 2491 Florence Harllee Blvd, broke ground 2023 and still under construction per March 2026 announcement; current-ops audit rejects under-construction. Not part of FTC divestiture.
